specification: AQA 8652 Higher, local v1.2 August 2026; first assessment 2026, target 2027
specification_sections: Linked prescribed grammar: agreement, reflexives, negatives, relative qui, perfect/imperfect/near future and regular -er future

questions_and_answers.format: Original paired practice ordered by marks
questions_and_answers.assessment_review: Theme 1 applies across all four papers. The extended practice uses the current writing formats: three bullet points and approximately 90 words for 15 marks, two bullet points and approximately 150 words for 25 marks. These are original tasks and models, not copied sample answers. Short translation marks are practice allocations; official full translations are assessed using the whole-response grids.

flashcards.type: Short bilingual retrieval and application; no category selector
